baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 4, the plural form-VIII participle from kh-l-f, is linked by the in-it construction to one shared referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The shared object holds the group together while the root image distributes its members onto mutually nonidentical courses. Difference is therefore relational and enacted, not merely a list of incompatible statements.

activation_trace.role: The image of companions taking different roads supplies a shared-object, divergent-course mechanism for the focus predicate.

changed_reading.before: They hold different opinions about it.
changed_reading.after: They remain oriented to one matter while taking mutually different courses within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 4 and the in-it construction permit the common referent to function as a field around which the plural subjects occupy different relations.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rear-versus-front and one-after-another images recast difference as positional or temporal distribution. The participants may be out of alignment in where they stand or in which phase they occupy, not only in what they assert.

activation_trace.role: The literal rear-versus-front relation makes spatial misalignment around the common referent available to the focus predicate.
The image of alternating succession makes different temporal phases another possible organization of the plural difference.

changed_reading.before: Their disagreement consists only of opposed propositions.
changed_reading.after: They are differently positioned or phased in relation to the same matter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 4 alone carries the kh-l-f inventory, including a branch in which an expected promise does not arrive at its set time.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch makes the reliability of an expected future a possible axis of the difference: the group may divide over whether what is anticipated will actually keep its appointment.

activation_trace.role: The image of a promise failing to meet its appointment supplies an exploratory reliability-of-the-future axis for the disagreement.

changed_reading.before: They disagree about the content of an unnamed matter.
changed_reading.after: They may be divided over whether an expected event will arrive as promised.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal questioning precedes the naming of an arriving report and then the focus predicate. The disagreement becomes a social process generated and displayed as one consequential report circulates through a questioning group.

activation_trace.role: Different roads anchor the group's divergent responses to one shared object.
Mutual asking literally supplies the reciprocal social exchange through which the divergent courses become audible.
An arriving, transmitted report supplies the common object whose circulation organizes the exchange.

structural_cues: 78:1 stages reciprocal questioning, 78:2 names its object, and 78:3 predicates divergence of the same plural group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual questioning, a transmitted report, and divergent courses; I infer that circulation of the report elicits or exposes those courses. A live alternative is that the questions merely publicize positions already formed elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: Separate individuals privately disagree about a proposition.
changed_reading.after: A group socially produces and exposes divergent courses while exchanging questions about an arriving report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate promise of disclosed knowledge develops into tasting as direct experience and finally looking at what one has advanced. Current divergence is therefore a provisional epistemic interval that will be displaced by personal encounter, not an indefinitely balanced debate.

activation_trace.role: The different-road image anchors the present plurality of positions that the later sequence transforms.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the first transition from present divergence toward recognition.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing turns abstract cognition into embodied verification.
Directed sight or insight supplies the final personal confrontation with what had been disputed.

structural_cues: The knowing clause is doubled at 78:4-5, then the surah shifts to second-person tasting at 78:30 and singular personal seeing at 78:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, experiential tasting, and directed seeing; I infer a progression that collapses the earlier epistemic distance. The alternative is that each act intensifies warning without producing shared agreement among the original disputants.

changed_reading.before: Their disagreement is a stable plurality of views.
changed_reading.after: Their disagreement is temporary distance from an encounter that will replace argument with knowing, undergoing, and seeing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's failed-appointment possibility is reversed by a judgment that separates, a struck appointment, a day fixed as real, and temporal nearness. The disagreement now includes whether the announced reckoning will keep its appointment, while the context repeatedly answers that it will.

activation_trace.role: A promise missing its appointment supplies the possibility that the disputed future might fail to arrive.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood gives the appointment a decisive function rather than a bare date.
A formally struck appointment directly counters the focus branch's image of an unmet time.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the appointment with ontological reliability.
Temporal nearness removes the imagined appointment from an indefinitely remote horizon.

structural_cues: 78:17 identifies one day as both separation and fixed appointment; 78:39 calls that day real; 78:40 presents the warned consequence as near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointment, decisive judgment, reality, and nearness; I read these as a contextual reversal of the focus root's failed-promise branch. The group could instead agree that an event will occur and differ only over its nature, so reliability is one live axis rather than the sole issue.

changed_reading.before: They differ over the content of an unspecified report.
changed_reading.after: They are also divided over whether a promised reckoning will arrive on schedule, and the context insists that the appointment will hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night and opened daylight alternate; rain is delivered from raining clouds; vegetation emerges. These sequences activate succession and renewal branches in the focus root, making the disagreement a clash over whether the world's repeated replacement and re-emergence pattern extends to the disputed human future.

activation_trace.role: Alternating succession supplies the focus predicate with a temporal replacement pattern.
Renewal after prior loss supplies the re-emergence side of the focus-root mechanism.
Night as darkness contrary to day provides one pole of an alternating cycle.
Day opening through light supplies the answering phase that replaces night.
Delivery from above provides the enabling transfer into the later growth sequence.
The raining-cloud image supplies the material release that precedes renewed growth.
Plant life emerging from earth gives visible form to renewal after an apparently inactive state.

structural_cues: 78:9-16 runs from rest through night and day to rain, emergence, and enclosed growth before 78:17 names the appointed separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating phases, delivered rain, and emergence; I infer an analogy from recurring natural renewal to the disputed human future. A live alternative is that the sequence establishes power and provision without modeling the event's process.

changed_reading.before: They disagree about an isolated future claim.
changed_reading.after: They take opposed readings of a visible succession-and-renewal pattern, especially over whether that pattern reaches their own future.

context_deltas.mechanism: Different courses are separated, arrive as cohorts, and receive recompense measured to match. The focus disagreement thus becomes trajectory: positions are embodied as ways of proceeding and are sorted into corresponding endpoints, including a passage poised between rescue and destruction.

activation_trace.role: Companions taking different roads anchor the conversion of disagreement into divergent trajectories.
Separation that makes a boundary visible supplies the sorting operation applied to the courses.
Human cohorts give collective, embodied form to what began as plural divergence.
An act met by its recompense supplies the causal link between a taken course and its endpoint.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart makes the outcome correspond to the course rather than follow arbitrarily.
A hazardous passage suspended between rescue and destruction supplies the spatial fork at which endpoints diverge.

structural_cues: The singular shared matter of 78:3 is followed by a day of separation, arrival in groups, and parallel consequence blocks in 78:21-30 and 78:31-36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation, cohorts, matched recompense, and a rescue-or-destruction passage; I infer that the earlier positions mature into courses and outcomes. The cohorts could instead be only a mode of arrival, with no one-to-one mapping to every earlier opinion.

changed_reading.before: They voice different views while remaining in one unresolved discussion.
changed_reading.after: They take different courses that will be separated into cohorts and answered by corresponding outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A solid raised mass first functions as stability, then the closed above opens and the mountains are displaced into mirage. This reversal activates the focus root's changed-state branch: the disagreement concerns rival readings of a world whose apparently fixed surfaces will not remain as they appear.

activation_trace.role: Different roads keep the changed-state activation attached to the subjects' rival readings.
A thing whose condition changes supplies the focus root with an alteration mechanism rather than simple verbal opposition.
A raised solid accumulation establishes the initial appearance of massive stability.
The opening and widening of what was closed begins the reversal of the built world's apparent fixity.
Displacement and removal turn the stable mass into something no longer fixed in place.
A mirage shining like water makes deceptive appearance the endpoint of the stability reversal.

structural_cues: Mountains appear as pegs at 78:7 and a strong structure is built above at 78:12; at 78:19-20 the above opens and the mountains become mirage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stability-to-mirage reversal; I infer that it diagnoses the disputants' reliance on incompatible readings of appearance. The sequence may instead demonstrate transforming power without explaining the psychology of disagreement.

changed_reading.before: They disagree over an unseen claim while the visible world remains a neutral backdrop.
changed_reading.after: They follow rival readings of reality while the surah exposes apparently solid surfaces as transformable and potentially deceptive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later plural assigns falsehood to visible signs, and the closing singular is characterized by covering truth. One branch of the initial divergence is therefore not merely uncertainty but an active practice of negating or obscuring available marks.

activation_trace.role: The different-road image anchors denial as one possible trajectory within the initial divergence.
Attributing falsehood to a thing or speaker gives one divergent course an active negating operation.
A visible sign supplies the material that the negating course refuses to credit.
Covering truth sharpens denial from an alternate view into an obscuring relation to what is available.

structural_cues: The plural denial at 78:28 follows the creation-sign sequence, while 78:40 closes with a singular representative of the covering course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible marks, plural denial, and a final truth-coverer; I infer that these identify one pole of the group in 78:3. A live alternative is that the later pronouns have a narrower or shifted referent, so not every initial difference is morally asymmetrical in this way.

changed_reading.before: The parties occupy evidentially neutral alternatives.
changed_reading.after: At least one divergent course actively assigns falsehood to visible marks and covers what they disclose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from reciprocal questioning and divergent courses to an environment without mixed idle noise or false speech, then to a court where no one controls address and only permitted, right speech occurs. The focus disagreement is embedded in a changing speech regime, from proliferating claims to radically constrained truthful utterance.

activation_trace.role: Different courses anchor the speech arc in the focus group's initial divergence.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the open, many-voiced starting condition.
Audible perception makes the absence of certain speech a property of the later environment.
Mixed vocal noise supplies the excluded form of proliferating, unproductive talk.
Speech contrary to truth supplies the second excluded form of discourse.
Exchange and review of speech defines the address that participants cannot command for themselves.
Intelligible utterance linking speakers supplies the speech act placed under restriction.
Permission supplies the gate that replaces uncontrolled mutual speech.
Voiced utterance gives concrete form to what may pass through the permission gate.
Right settled opposite error supplies the criterion for the speech that remains.

structural_cues: The opening sequence is questioning-report-difference; 78:35 removes idle and false speech; 78:37-38 removes autonomous address and permits only right speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the opening exchange and the later exclusions and permissions; I infer a speech-regime arc that reframes the focus predicate. The alternative is that the later speech rules describe outcome settings without resolving the earlier group's divergent claims.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports a free-standing disagreement about content.
changed_reading.after: The disagreement is the noisy opening state of a surah-wide speech arc that ends with false and idle talk absent and right speech permission-bound.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhaustive counting and writing preserve every item, while the closing person sees what the hands sent forward. Divergent courses are no longer weightless opinions: they become authored acts that enter a complete record and return to confront their maker.

activation_trace.role: Taking different roads anchors the move from stated positions to enacted courses.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration prevents any part of a course from disappearing from view.
Ordered writing supplies the durable record into which the enumerated course is gathered.
Advancing something forward turns a present course into a prior act awaiting its agent.
What the hands earn assigns practical authorship to the recorded trajectory.

structural_cues: 78:29 gathers every thing into an exhaustive written account; 78:40 individualizes the return by making each person inspect what was sent ahead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete recording and hand-authored prior acts; I infer that the differing courses include conduct and not only propositions. The record plainly exceeds this one dispute, so the focus disagreement should not be equated with the whole account.

changed_reading.before: Their different views have no stated material persistence.
changed_reading.after: Their different courses are practically authored, exhaustively recorded, and later encountered as what each person sent ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant s-l-l target for the questioning root and is not a lexical gloss of the surface verb. It remains valid as an activation because the packet explicitly preserves that split mapping and the focus supplies one shared field with different roads. Downstream prose should label it a branch-driven image: reciprocal questioning draws distinct strands or routes out of a common matter.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 anchors distinct courses inside one shared in-it field; the outlier changes how those courses become manifest rather than replacing the focus predicate.

activation_trace.role: Different roads keep the extracted-strand image attached to the focus group's divergence.
Extracted paths or strands supply an image in which questioning draws latent routes out of the shared matter.

changed_reading.before: Questions merely reveal already separate opinions.
changed_reading.after: Reciprocal questioning can be pictured as drawing distinct strands or pathways out of one common object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatial reading is surprising because neither branch should replace the ordinary disagreement sense. It remains anchored through the focus root's passage image and the later rescue-or-destruction passage, both inside the packet. Downstream prose should present it as a contained spatial model: the disputants are route-finders in one hazardous terrain, not as a new translation of word 4.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 carries a branch image of a passage through constricted terrain, while the in-it construction supplies the shared space through which routes can diverge.

activation_trace.role: A passage leading through terrain from constriction toward openness supplies the focus with a literal route-space.
A wilderness poised between rescue and destruction turns the shared route-space into consequential hazard.

changed_reading.before: They occupy opposed propositions about one event.
changed_reading.after: They can be pictured as taking different routes through one hazardous passage whose exits tend toward rescue or destruction.

strongest_changes: The disagreement became a socially enacted exchange around an arriving report, then part of a speech arc that ends with false and idle talk excluded and right speech permission-bound.
It became provisional epistemic distance that moves toward disclosed knowledge, embodied experience, and personal seeing.
The focus root's failed-appointment possibility was reversed by separation, fixed timing, reality, and nearness, exposing reliability of the promised future as one axis of dispute.
Different views became courses that are separated into cohorts, answered by matching outcomes, and preserved as recorded deeds.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated mechanisms that a local reading would miss: recurring alternation and renewal, stability collapsing into mirage, an opening-to-closing speech regime, and a record that converts positions into accountable trajectories. The preserved non-dominant mapping for the opening question also supported a contained extracted-strands outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The referential continuity between the group in 78:1-3 and later plural or singular actors is strongly suggested but not grammatically guaranteed at every point.
The natural alternation and growth sequence may function as an analogy for renewed human emergence, or more minimally as evidence of power and provision.
Form-distant kh-l-f branches such as failed appointment, changed state, and terrain passage are diagnostic activations, not secure lexical senses of the form-VIII predicate.
The later regulation of speech may resolve the opening disagreement, or it may only describe environments in which that disagreement can no longer be voiced freely.
